title.en: An Act Adopting Mr. Ray Higgins as Son of the Philippines, and Conferring Upon Him All the Rights, Privileges and Prerogatives of Philippine Citizenship

text.en: Mr. Ray Higgins, an American resident in the Philippines, is hereby adopted as son of the Philippines and conferred all the rights, privileges and prerogatives of Philippine citizenship.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1955.
